object_suffix: six colored counts, six phyrexian counts, fifteen unordered hybrid-pair counts; all divided by eight
hybrid_pair_order: i then j, 0 <= i < j < 6, using colors order
token_mapping: zero is an all-zero dummy; otherwise card_id equals token minus one
information: Only tokens already present in the actor-visible native V4 object rows. Global effects come only from that actor observation. No registration or hidden-state access.
cost_meaning: Registry front-face printed mana cost, not current payment, affinity reduction, alternative cost, activated ability cost, transformed-face cost, or X choice.
state_meaning: Current public global shield colors and separate cannot-prevent flag; preserve both if prevention is suspended.
deployment: Separate auxiliary contract. Not accepted as unchanged V4 model input, not yet a trained successor.
